summary: Frontend-only verification of Admin > Database tab rework. Admin login succeeded and /admin auto-routed. Database tab renders db-viewer with 4 labelled groups (People, Analyst, Site content, Settings & system); Broker & market group correctly absent (its collections don't exist in preview). Chip 'site_content' present under Site content; old 'content' chip absent (whitelist bug fixed). Auto-discovered chip counts: managers 2, partner_applications 2, users 12, analyst_invites 7, analyst_portfolios 1, faqs 6, leads 0, site_content 1, app_settings 1 (9 collections). Redaction verified: users password_hash shows '••• redacted •••'; analyst_invites code_hash shows '••• redacted •••'. Typed-confirm dialog for 'users': input present, confirm disabled while empty, disabled while typing 'wrong', ENABLED once 'users' typed exactly — cancelled without confirming (no destructive action taken). Regression: search 'admin' on users returns 1 record (admin@omnivest.in); Export CSV button present. Pagination not applicable (users=12<=25).
observations: For collections with 0 records (e.g., leads), the 'Clear collection' trigger button (data-testid='db-clear-btn') is disabled (opacity-40, disabled attr) because dbTotal===0. This prevents opening the clear dialog on empty collections. Spec said 'confirm works (deleting 0 records is fine)'; the current UX skips the dialog entirely for empty collections, which is a reasonable behavior but diverges from the literal spec. Not a functional bug — flag as design decision to confirm with main agent.
action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: If spec strictly requires clear-dialog to open even for empty collections, remove the dbTotal===0 disable on db-clear-btn (AdminPage.jsx line 635) for non-protected collections. Otherwise keep as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx is very large (700+ lines). Consider splitting Database tab into a separate component/hook for maintainability.

Redaction logic on backend (dbadmin.py) — verify tuple ('password','hash','secret','token','code','otp') doesn't accidentally over-redact fields like 'firstname' or 'passcode'-adjacent legitimate strings (tuple matching should be case-insensitive substring; sample data validates it works).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 verified the reworked Admin > Database tab. All required flows passed. Only minor observation: db-clear-btn is disabled when collection count=0, so the clear-dialog path can't be verified live on 'leads' (0 records). Broker & market group and instruments search-first UX cannot be tested in preview since those collections don't exist — main agent already curl-verified backend.
